name: Acceptance turn A
description: The acceptance run's turns fixture (§5.4 "Turns"): it and its twin take one turn and write while they hold it. It offers that turn, `slot`, to other plugins.

turns.name: slot
turns.doc: The acceptance run's one slot: one plugin writes at a time.

commands.name: span
commands.description: Takes the slot, writes its start and end while it holds it, then lets go.

commands.name: hold
commands.description: Takes the slot and keeps it: when it got it, its until, and this host process's pid.

commands.name: spans
commands.description: What it wrote while it held the slot.

commands.name: nosy
commands.description: Tries a turn the other plugin doesn't offer.
